mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_http_command(tenant_id,endpoint,command_key,actor_id,request_hash,http_status) VALUES(#{tenant},#{endpoint},CAST(#{key} AS uuid),#{actor},#{hash},#{status}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT actor_id,request_hash,response_json,http_status FROM erp_http_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND endpoint=#{endpoint} AND command_key=CAST(#{key} AS uuid) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_http_command SET response_json=#{json} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND endpoint=#{endpoint} AND command_key=CAST(#{key} AS uuid) AND response_json IS NULL
